pieces.name: engine/bootstrap
pieces.summary: WebGPURenderer + WebGL2 fallback. Low-res RT upscale, TSL grade/dither/vignette, fog-as-draw-distance murk.

pieces.name: input/pointer+twin-stick
pieces.summary: Unified pointer events: twin-stick touch + context button, pointerlock mouse + WASD.

pieces.name: world/town
pieces.summary: Textured town: procedural 64px nearest-filtered textures, porches, shutters, lit windows, church, graveyard w/ key light, navGrid.

pieces.name: characters/faces
pieces.summary: Sphere heads w/ jaw taper, 32px face textures (man/woman/pale/turned), hair per archetype, tattered player silhouette.

pieces.name: tsl/era effects
pieces.summary: Vertex jitter on ALL materials (verified 26% px delta); affine warp WebGPU-only (GLSL noperspective breaks SwiftShader).

pieces.name: ai/residents+horde
pieces.summary: 60 NPCs staggered think; horde hunts women autonomously, exponential spread, rings player when lineage complete.

pieces.name: gore/visceral
pieces.summary: Dismemberment w/ persistent thrown limbs, wall spray, timed take bursts + drips, arterial trails, body pools, model staining.

pieces.name: take-cut/first-person
pieces.summary: Hard cut to first-person per take, lurch, handheld shake, snap back. Kiss/kill decided by target.

pieces.name: hud/bars+prompt
pieces.summary: Hunger/rot/evidence bars, stage, horde counts, KISS/KILL context prompt.

pieces.name: escalation/town states
pieces.summary: Clustering, armed men w/ rifles + fire, pallbearer screening, cordon roadblocks + timer.

pieces.name: audio/CC0 pack + director
pieces.summary: 22 CC0 files, kill=impact+wet+breath+tail. Director: positional horde converts, dread drone by stage, heartbeat, stings.

pieces.name: mood/critic
pieces.summary: R6 (final) judging now: fog murk + graveyard key light fixed R5 gaps.

pieces.name: smoothing+perf
pieces.summary: Integration conflict hunt + pacing sim + frame budget harness running.
